t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different coloured gnomes relate to two different basket colours. One of these baskets gives more mushrooms. But this changes over time. The person then switched the baskets around each time they were getting lower mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 different colour gnomes, 4 will be associated with a red basket and 4 will be associated with a yellow basket. When one basket has dropped below a certain amount of mushrooms, I swapped when it was only paying 2 or 3 mushrooms (10 or 15 if the 5x multiplier was on) though occasionally both baskets were not paying well. So swap between the baskets when you think you aren't getting enough mushrooms
